description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Chameleon.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Chameleon.
Activate Chameleon by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Chameleon ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

uses.name: Chameleon, Master of Disguise
uses.cardState: as a copy of Forensic Researcher and without summoning sickness
